description: Real programming logic: variables, data types and operators, conditionals, loops, functions, arrays, and objects, ending in a mini project combining all of it.
levelTitle: Level 1: Core Web Standards & Styling Architecture

lessons.title: JavaScript and the Browser
lessons.description: Understand what JavaScript actually does in the browser, how it responds to events, and how it changes the live page through the DOM.
lessons.originalIntent: Understand what JavaScript actually does in the browser, how it responds to events, and how it changes the live page through the DOM.

lessons.title: Variables and Values
lessons.description: Learn how let and const give JavaScript names for values, how reassignment works, and why choosing the right declaration makes code easier to reason about.
lessons.originalIntent: Learn how let and const give JavaScript names for values, how reassignment works, and why choosing the right declaration makes code easier to reason about.

lessons.title: Data Types and Operators
lessons.description: Learn the core JavaScript data types and the operators used to calculate, compare, and combine values, with special attention to strict equality and type coercion.
lessons.originalIntent: Learn the core JavaScript data types and the operators used to calculate, compare, and combine values, with special attention to strict equality and type coercion.

lessons.title: Conditions and Decisions
lessons.description: Use if, else if, else, and switch to make JavaScript choose what to do based on conditions.
lessons.originalIntent: Use if, else if, else, and switch to make JavaScript choose what to do based on conditions.

lessons.title: Loops and Repetition
lessons.description: Practice repeating work with for and while loops, control iteration safely, and avoid the classic off-by-one and infinite-loop mistakes.
lessons.originalIntent: Practice repeating work with for and while loops, control iteration safely, and avoid the classic off-by-one and infinite-loop mistakes.

lessons.title: Functions
lessons.description: Learn how functions package reusable logic, accept inputs through parameters, and produce results through return values.
lessons.originalIntent: Learn how functions package reusable logic, accept inputs through parameters, and produce results through return values.

lessons.title: Arrays
lessons.description: Learn how arrays store ordered collections of values and use push, map, and filter to add, transform, and select data.
lessons.originalIntent: Learn how arrays store ordered collections of values and use push, map, and filter to add, transform, and select data.

lessons.title: Objects
lessons.description: Learn how JavaScript objects model real-world entities with named properties, and practice reading and updating data with dot and bracket notation.
lessons.originalIntent: Learn how JavaScript objects model real-world entities with named properties, and practice reading and updating data with dot and bracket notation.

lessons.title: JavaScript Mini Project
lessons.description: Build a small working learner-progress application that combines variables, conditionals, loops, functions, arrays, and objects into one coherent JavaScript program.
lessons.originalIntent: Build a small working learner-progress application that combines variables, conditionals, loops, functions, arrays, and objects into one coherent JavaScript program.
